comments.body: where and how can i get this?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Two ways I know of.

#1: Gain court ranks. When you reach #19 (Knight), your nation's crest will be handed over at the time you receive your promotion. (I'm guessing you're Dutch, btw, or else this step obviously won't apply.)
#2: Select the crest from Ganador Prize Exchange Box 1 -- this particular item can be manufactured at the Ganador camp from the NPC named Military Man.
